{{Quote|I feel genuinely sorry for any hostile who has the misfortune to face Delta Squad in combat.|[[Walon Vau]]|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
'''Delta Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] that carried out demanding missions for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Comprised of four [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Delta Squad included [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140]] "Fixer," [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], and [[Scorch/Legends|Scorch]]. One of the twenty-five squads that comprised [[Arca Company]] of the [[Commando Group]] [[Zero Five Commando]] in the Grand Army's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], Delta Squad took their orders from the [[Director of Special Forces]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Arligan Zey]], along with Zey's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Bardan Jusik]] for much of the war, and then from Jusik's replacement, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]. During several missions, the unit was also overseen in the field by [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]] [[01/425]].

First [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|deployed]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] at the start of the Clone Wars, Delta Squad would go on to play an instrumental role in the [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|recapture]] of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|RAS]] ''[[Prosecutor]]'', as well as the [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|rescue]] of fellow commando unit, [[Omega Squad]]. In conjunction with Omega, and working with two of the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s under the direction of former ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]], Delta would take part in the [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|shut down]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terror cell]] operating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The squad would be tasked with locating the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] defector [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], though their search would turn up nothing but the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist's]] severed head. Delta Squad would again prove invaluable to the Republic in the lead up to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], where they were able to [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|rescue]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] from his [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] captors, defend Wookiee villages from Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and even destroy a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]]. However, it was on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that Delta Squad would be forced to abandon one of their own, the commando known as Sev, when he came under fire and the squad received orders from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] himself to immediately pull out. Delta Squad would go on to serve the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-formed]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], where they were given a replacement for Sev, and tasked with hunting down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had escaped [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], along with [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] deserters, Jedi sympathizers, and other Imperial dissidents.

==History==
===Youth and training===
The four members of Delta Squad were born in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Clone military education complex|facilities]] of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. During their youth, they received [[flash training]] much like the rest of the developing [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="RepCom" /> but the majority of their training came from [[Walon Vau]], one of the seventy-five [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] in the one-hundred-man group known as the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''. Hand-picked by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] himself, Vau believed that in order for his commandos to survive in combat, he must train them as harshly as possible—to do anything less would compromise their training.<ref name="TZ" /> Seen as brutal by many, including his fellow ''Cuy'val Dar'' training sergeants, Vau's practices made Delta Squad an aggressive, but supremely efficient unit and they were truly grateful toward the man for making them into survivors.<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> Vau took great pride in his squads' consistently high performance, both in live-fire exercises on Kamino and later during their deployment in the Clone Wars.<ref name="RepCom" /><ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> During their training, the four [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] adopted names to go along with their formal numerical designations. [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|RC-1138]], the squad's [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], became known as "Boss", while [[RC-1140/Legends|RC-1140]] took on the name "Fixer". [[Scorch/Legends|RC-1262]] earned himself the nickname of "Scorch", following an incident with explosive ordnance that left both 62 and Sergeant Vau without eyebrows for a period of time,<ref name="RepCom" /> and [[Sev/Legends|RC-1207]] became known as "Sev", short for his designation's final digit, seven.<ref name="O66" />

===Battle of Geonosis===
{{Quote|The squad objective remains: find Sun Fac, and eliminate him. I will be issuing further orders as you go. Good luck, commando.|01/425 to Boss|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:DeltaSquad_RCcover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Delta Squad in action.]]
Delta Squad's intensive training on Kamino would come to an end in the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. During his pursuit of the [[Clone template/Legends|progenitor]] of Delta Squad, as well as the rest of the clone army, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] traveled to the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] where he was captured by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces. His [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] would attempt to rescue Kenobi, but would fail and instead join him in captivity. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] moved with a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi strike team]] to rescue the three captives, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] traveled to Kamino to see the recently discovered Grand Army for himself.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> The Grand Army, and Delta Squad with it, would be sent to Geonosis in a deployment so hastily ordered and carried out that it would leave Delta with no time to say goodbye to their training sergeant, Vau.<ref name="TZ" /> The four commandos split up, each boarding a single [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] independently, with the intention of rendezvousing once on the surface of Geonosis.<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:Adviser.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[01/425]] communicates with Delta Squad.]]
Overseen by [[Advisor/Legends|clone advisor]] [[01/425]] during their part in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Delta Squad was tasked with [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] Geonosian [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser's]] chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Sun Fac/Legends|Sun Fac]]. Once on the ground, Delta Squad's sergeant, Boss, was called upon to destroy an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] bunker on his way to rendezvous with the other members of his squad, a task he completed utilizing a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="RepCom" /> Upon the reunion of the four commandos, Delta Squad attacked Sun Fac in his command center, although the Geonosian leader would manage to escape. Delta would track Fac through the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|Geonosian catacombs]], eventually catching up with him in Fac's private hangar as the Geonosian attempted to escape in his [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Fac's escape was prevented by the timely actions of Delta Squad's [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], Sev, who used the sniping attachment of his [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to shoot down the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], killing Fac. While in the hangar, Delta Squad would also witness the departure of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' personal starfighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], although they were unable to recognize it for what it was at the time.<ref name="RepCom" /> While hunting for Sun Fac, Delta Squad had engaged a number of [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|spider droids]] while their fellow Republic commando unit, [[Theta Squad]], [[Thermal detonator tape|blew]] through a door in the catacombs. Once the door was down, Delta was given leave to enter and fire on the Geonosians inside,<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> while Theta moved off to destroy a [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factory]]. Once Sun Fac was dead, Delta Squad was informed via their advisor that Theta Squad had failed in their objective;<ref name="RepCom" /> [[Taler (clone commando)|three]] [[Vin (clone commando)|of the]] [[Jay (clone commando)|four]] commandos had been [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] the only survivor.<ref name="HC" /> Delta would infiltrate the factory—their route taking them through an area filled with Geonosian [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]—and successfully destroy it by targeting specific weak points in the factory's design.<ref name="RepCom" />

Following the destruction of the droid factory, Delta Squad was tasked with the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|infiltration]] of a [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]]. Deployed in a nearby canyon from a LAAT/i gunship [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Delta 42]], Delta Squad was quickly ambushed by Geonosian forces. Though outnumbered, they soon came upon a downed gunship and two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]; though the troopers would fall to the Geonosians, Delta Squad was able to commandeer one of the gunship's [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bubble-turrets in order to fend off the enemy.<ref name="RepCom" /> As they continued toward the Core Ship, the squad was called upon to take out an [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|anti-aircraft cannon]]. Delta fought through a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], before finally destroying the large anti-aircraft emplacement. When the squad finally reached the Core Ship, they were met with resistance from an [[A-DSD advanced dwarf spider droid|advanced spider droid]], and a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] blocking the ship's entrance. The four commandos were able to destroy the spider droid with considerable effort—with Boss making note of his desire never to have to engage one again—and they then called in air-support from Delta 42's gunship to blow through the ray shielded entrance.<ref name="RepCom" /> Once inside, Delta Squad split up, each of its members tasked with sabotaging and destroying various crucial systems. Scorch and Fixer came under heavy fire from a small number of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], but Boss and Sev were able to rescue them without incident. Their primary objective was the capture of vital launch codes housed on the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. On the bridge, Delta came under heavy fire from numerous battle droids and stationary [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]], but still managed to acquire the codes before retreating down a branching corridor. By this point in time, the squad's efforts to sabotage the Core Ship had come to full fruition, with several primary systems overloading. With no time to make an escape back the way they had come, Delta Squad was extracted via LAAT/i gunship through a hole forcefully blown in the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] the ship.<ref name="RepCom" />

Delta Squad's actions in retrieving the Core Ship's launch codes would allow the Republic to hault the evacuation of several other fleeing ships. They were also the first Republic force to successfully breach a vessel of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist]] alliance now known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="RepCom" /> Delta Squad would be among the few squads of Republic commandos to survive the battle on Geonosis intact, taking no casualties to its ranks when 4,982 other commandos perished during the battle.<ref name="O66" />

===Mission to the ''Prosecutor''===
{{Dialogue|Advisor 01/425|We're sending our most qualified squad to investigate. Someone important noted your excellence on Geonosis.|Scorch|You hear that, Sev? Someone thinks ''I'm'' excellent.|Sev|Well...at least that makes ''two'' of you.|attr=Prior to the mission to the ''Prosecutor''|src=<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:Prosecutor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Delta Squad is sent to investigate the RAS ''Prosecutor'']]
The battle on Geonosis would turn out to be only the start of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Three hundred and sixty-seven days into the war, now in the year [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Delta Squad was called upon to [[Mission to the Chaykin Cluster|investigate]] the derelict [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], ''[[Prosecutor]]''. Delta Squad had spent a substantial amount of time aboard the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] during the early portion of the war, even coming to think of it as their "first home". Having recently reappeared in the [[Chaykin Cluster|Chaykin cluster]] following a two-week-long disappearance while tasked with defending [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], the ''Prosecutor'' was found drifting without power and unresponsive to communication attempts. They were specifically chosen for the mission due to the impact their actions on Geonosis had on an individual higher up the Republic chain of command. Arriving on scene in the [[Corbantis system/Legends|Corbantis system]] aboard a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]], Delta Squad was tasked with retrieving flight records from the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} four data cores and securing the derelict [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]].<ref name="RepCom" />

The four members of Delta Squad disembarked from the CR25 via a jump through the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], splitting up and entering the ''Prosecutor'' at four different locations—Boss entered the assault ship through one of its [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] launch tubes. Shortly after boarding the ship, their communications with [[01/425]], who was again serving as mission advisor to the squad, were mysteriously cut off. While searching through the ship, Delta Squad came across few survivors, and several members were set upon by [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]], including Scorch, who was ambushed and incapacitated by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Shortly after, the squad found that the ''Prosecutor'' has been attacked by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Trandoshan Elites|mercenaries]] when Sev was captured at the starboard data core, and Boss forced to flee into the ship's maintenance shafts.<ref name="RepCom" /> Boss and Fixer were able to complete their original objectives, battling through heavily armed and armored Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and the ship's very own autoturret defenses that had been [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] by the Trandoshans, before rendezvousing and proceeding to rescue Sev. Once Sev was free of the violent interrogation from his Trandoshan captors, the incomplete squad moved to retrieve Scorch from where he was being held in the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[detention area]]. After a brief skirmish in the detention area, Delta Squad was able to locate and revive an incapacitated Scorch, and together make their way to the bridge where they destroyed a Confederacy [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]] and re-established communication with their advisor.<ref name="RepCom" />

[[File:Arrestor.png|thumb|left|250px|The RAS ''Arrestor'', defending the ''Prosecutor'' and Delta Squad from Separatist attack]]
After [[Scanner|scanning]] the assault ship, 01/425 was able to determine that a [[Trandoshan dropship]] had touched down in one of the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays. Delta Squad proceeded to head toward the hangar, but a booby-trapped [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] left Delta stuck back in the ship's detention area and under attack by Trandoshan mercenaries. Repairing the cell block's damaged systems, Delta Squad was able to trigger the detention area into lockdown, flooding the area with noxious gas that neutralized the Trandoshans while sparing the commandos who were safe inside their sealed [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class armor]]. The squad escaped the locked-down detention area into a [[garbage pit]], and moved on to the hangar where they successfully used the Trandoshans' own [[Multiple Missile Launch Turret|rocket turret]] to destroy the dropship.<ref name="RepCom" /> Unfortunately for the commandos of Delta Squad, a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] had entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was rapidly approaching the ''Prosecutor''. While their advisor called for assistance, Delta Squad was charged with repelling the [[Battle droid dispenser|droid]] [[B2 battle droid dispenser|boarding]] [[Droideka dispenser|parties]] and sealing the assault ship's hangars. By the time Delta Squad reached the final hangar, it was heavily overrun with droids and therefore the commandos commandeered the roof-mounted [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]] of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] to deal with the overwhelming droid threat.<ref name="RepCom" /> Although the Confederacy had initially been interested in obtaining the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] from the Trandoshans in exchange for battle droids, following these losses, the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] instead opened fire on the ''Prosecutor'', intent on destroying it before reinforcements could arrive. In an attempt to hold off the battleship, Delta Squad struggled to get the ''Prosecutor''{{'s}} turbolaser battery array back online amidst a continuing assault from droid forces already onboard. Reinforcements would come in the form of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Talbot]] and the RAS [[Arrestor (Acclamator-class)|''Arrestor'']], the only Republic force to respond to 01/425's calls for assistance. Between the combined strength of the ''Arrestor'' and ''Prosecutor''—even as the latter's hull integrity was compromised—the Conferacy [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]] was destroyed, shutting down the battle droids aboard the ''Prosecutor'', and saving both the ship and the lives of Delta Squad.<ref name="RepCom" />

For their actions aboard the ''Prosecutor'', Delta Squad would be commended by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] Mace Windu, and the data gathered by the commandos would help the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to curb the efforts of Trandoshan slavers in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="RepCom" />

===Rescue of Omega Squad===
{{Quote|DELTA SQUAD TO FLEET OPS. RESPOND TO RED ZERO. POSITION: CHAYKIN SECTOR. ETA: 1 STANDARD HOUR 40. CAN ASSIST: MEDICAL AND OXYGEN. PLEASE NOTE: DEPLOYING IN REQUISITIONED NEIMOIDIAN VESSEL. NO DEFENSIVE CAPACITY. REPEAT: NEGATIVE ARMAMENT. STRONGLY ADVISE ANY GAR VESSELS TO PING TRANSPONDER BEFORE OPENING FIRE. BE AWARE THAT SEPARATIST TRAFFIC IN SECTOR HAS INCREASED IN LAST 20 MINUTES IN RESPONSE TO FLEET MOVEMENT. PREP FOR UNWANTED COMPANY.|Delta Squad to [[Fleet Ops]], responding to Omega Squad's request for immediate extraction|<ref name="TZ" />}}
[[File:Repcommandos.png|thumb|right|170px|Delta Squad in mission.]]
Delta Squad departed the ''Prosecutor'' aboard a stolen, unarmed [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], and shortly thereafter received a [[Red Zero]] signal—the GAR code requesting immediate extraction from another commando unit, [[Omega Squad]], in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]]. Omega was trapped aboard a [[Gizer L-6 freighter|damaged]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]–[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection, with no power, limited [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], and a [[M'truli|trio]] [[Gysk|of]] [[Farr Orjul|prisoners]] suspected of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] activity, which they had [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|captured]] during an earlier [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|Traffic Interdiction Operation]]. With no other Republic forces close enough to provide the much-needed assistance, Delta Squad took it upon themselves to respond, and arrived first on the scene. As Scorch began rescue operations, a Separatist ship of Neimoidian manufacture arrived a short distance away. Before the enemy ship could open fire on the stranded commandos, the timely arrival of the RAS ''[[Fearless]]'' from hyperspace, also responding to Omega Squad's Red Zero, brought about the destruction of the Separatist craft via a pair of hastily-fired [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. Delta Squad was then able to successfully complete the extraction of Omega Squad and the prisoners, with Scorch cutting through the freighter's forward [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] and attaching a docking tube from their vessel to the freighter to allow for cross-decking. During their brief time together aboard Delta's stolen ship, Sev provoked Omega Squad member [[Atin Skirata|Atin]] into a confrontation that nearly came to blows, a confrontation over their shared history as commandos both trained by Walon Vau. The fight was broken up by Omega Squad's sergeant, [[Niner Skirata|Niner]], before any punches could be thrown. Both commando squads docked aboard ''Fearless'', though while Omega was reunited with their old friend [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], Delta Squad moved off together into an isolated corner of the hangar deck where they could talk amongst themselves during the journey back to [[Arca Company Barracks]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TZ" />

===Anti-terror operations===
{{Quote|Vau made you into very impatient boys. Yes, this is where it gets boring. And you know what? You won't be any less dead if you get it wrong. And I really hope Vau schooled you well in this, because I'll be pretty hacked off if you get trigger-happy and blow this op.''"<br />"''We're pros, Sarge. We know how to do this.|Kal Skirata and Boss|<ref name="TZ" />}}
[[File:Delta_Squad1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The members of Delta Squad]]
Upon setting down on Coruscant, Delta Squad disembarked from ''Fearless'' along with Omega, and were met by former ''Cuy'val Dar'' training sergeant, and now military advisor to [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]], [[Kal Skirata]]. Unfortunately for the four commandos, Skirata overheard Scorch's disparaging comments made at the expense of his advanced age, and ordered the squad to perform fifty pushups. Once they were finished—although Skirata teased that they had only completed forty of the fifty he'd assigned—Delta helped Omega offload the three prisoners into a waiting [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] piloted by Skirata's Wookiee associate, [[Enacca]], bound for interrogation at the hands of Delta's former training sergeant, Walon Vau. A transport arrived soon after to take Delta and Omega back to Arca Barracks.<ref name="TZ" /> At 1500 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], Delta met with Skirata and Omega Squad in one of [[Special Operations Brigade Headquarters]]' briefing rooms, where Skirata attempted to ease the tension between the two squads, insisting that Atin and Sev leave behind their grudge and shake hands. When the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] known as [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] arrived at the meeting, Skirata informed both Delta and Omega that they would be involved in a black ops [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|strike against a terrorist cell]] operating on Coruscant.<ref name="TZ" />

Delta Squad, along with Omega and the other members of the covertly assembled strike team—now including Jedi Generals Tur-Mukan and [[Bardan Jusik]], along with Vau and Vau's pet [[strill]], [[Lord Mirdalan]]—moved into the top floor of [[Qibbu's Hut/Legends|Qibbu's Hut]], a shady [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Entertainment District]], owned by an associate of Skirata by the name of [[Qibbu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Over the following days, members of Delta Squad would take part in a rotating surveillance watch with the members of Omega, and despite conflicts between members of the two squads where their distinct personalities clashed, the two squads worked together effectively and even came to develop a respect for one another. Together, they managed to root out a [[Vinna Jiss|traitor]] in the Grand Army's [[logistics center]], who was attempting to meet with a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Paxaz Izhiq|contact]].<ref name="TZ" /> Using Qibbu's criminal contacts, the strike team was able to lure their terrorist targets under the pretense of having a supply of five-hundred-grade thermal [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] explosive that they were willing to sell. While Skirata acted as the strike team's public face, meeting with members of the terror cell—including its leader, [[Perrive]]—Sev and Scorch teamed with Omega Squad's Darman and [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] to mark the terrorists with [[Dust|specially designed tracers]] with Skirata's personally owned [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Verpine shatter gun|sniper rifles]]. When the terrorists—now identified as [[Homeworld/Legends|hailing]] from [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] via their accents—took the explosive sample to be tested, Sev and Scorch returned to Qibbu's with the rest of the strike team. Later, while performing reconnaissance on the marked terrorists whereabouts, Sev dislocated his shoulder while attempting to outperform Fi. Fortunately, Fi was able to put the joint back into socket and Sev was able to continue operating.<ref name="TZ" />

[[File:RC-1207_Sev.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Delta Squad's expert sniper, Sev]]
Following a meeting between Skirata and the terrorist leader Perrive during which they set up a time when they would supposedly make the explosives drop, Delta Squad would spend an evening enjoying themselves at Qibbu's bar with the other member's of the strike team, at least until the revelry was cut short by a call from Perrive stating they would need to move up their time and change the pre-established location. Fortunately, the new location for the trade was a [[CoruFresh]] produce distribution depot in [[Quadrant F-76]] of Galactic City, a location Delta Squad had personally reconnoitered previously. Together with the other strike team members, Delta Squad donned their armor again for the first time since the operation had truly begun, and moved out to end the terrorist threat. The squad split up upon arrival, with Sev partnering with Ordo and Fixer with Atin; Boss and Scorch stayed together, covering the depot's landing strip.<ref name="TZ" /> Once Skirata and Jusik passed the explosives off to the terrorists and cleared the area as planned, the assembled troops struck, shutting off the lights and attacking from every direction, including the roof. Delta Squad neutralized the terrorists who fled into the [[Speeder truck/Legends|repulsor truck]] they had loaded the explosives in, ensuring that there would be no desperate suicidal detonation. A [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] strike nearly wounded Scorch, but Delta's demolitions man escaped only shaken.<ref name="TZ" />

Once the terrorists had all been killed—the assault taking no more than nine standard [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] in total—Delta and the others returned to Qibbu's for a final night, and then attended an evening as guests of the [[Coruscant Security Force Staff and Social Club|CSF Social Club]]. But just six days later, Delta Squad would be back on assignment, shipped off to [[Skuumaa]] and tasked with battlefield preparation consisting of sabotaging strategic targets ahead of the main Republic assault.<ref name="TZ" />

===Recon on Devaron===
[[File:DeltaSquad-WOTM.png|thumb|left|250px|Delta Squad returns from Devaron]]
{{Quote|There were no survivors on Devaron. Everyone was killed, including Master Halsey and his Padawan.|Boss, reporting on the events on Devaron|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the commandos of Delta Squad were dispatched to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] in the aftermath of [[Devaron massacre/Legends|battle waged there]]. They were ordered to search for survivors of the engagement. Finding none, they recovered the bodies of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], and returned them to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Upon landing at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the squad was met by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], who concluded that the deaths of the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and his apprentice were a sign of a new threat to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|the Republic]]. Their suspicion was confirmed when security footage of the massacre was recovered which including a hologram of Halsey's death at the hands of an [[Savage Opress/Legends|as-yet unknown]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist" />

===Mission to Mygeeto===
{{Quote|Sarge, we got what we came for. Why are we robbing a bank?''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''You're'' not robbing it. ''I'm'' robbing it. You're just opening a door.|Scorch and Walon Vau|<ref name="TC" />}}
[[File:Commando_1c.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Scorch, Boss, and Sev]]
Four hundred and seventy days after Geonosis, Delta Squad had been sent to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. The squad had been tasked with calling in air strikes and sabotaging Mygeetan ground defenses near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jygat]] in preparation for [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines']] [[Battle of Mygeeto|main assault]]. Delta completed their assignments as ordered, but instead of exfiltrating as they were supposed to, the commandos instead decided to assist their former training sergeant Vau in his personal mission, one that consisted of robbing Mygeeto's own [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]]. While Fixer held position near the squad's [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] on the planet's surface, the remaining three members of Delta followed Vau into the underground halls of the [[Bank/Legends|bank]], where Scorch proceeded to electronically disable the locks on the main vault's door.<ref name="TC" /> Once inside, however, Vau refused to allow the squad to assist him any further in the heist, determined not to compromise his trainees' integrity by directly involving them in the actual act of stealing. It was during Vau's raid on the vault's numerous safety deposit boxes that Delta Squad learned of their former training sergeant's past as a disinherited [[Count of Gesl|aristocrat]] from [[Irmenu]], and that the purpose of the theft was to regain the inheritance his [[Walon Vau's mother|mother]] and [[Walon Vau's father|father]] had denied him. When Vau ordered Delta to leave him and continue on with their assigned mission, the squad refused—reminding Vau that he was no longer a sergeant, just a civilian—and instead assisted Vau and his strill carry the stolen loot out of the bank.<ref name="TC" />

Unfortunately for both Delta Squad and Vau, their exit would become complicated when one of the bank's alarms was triggered. Although Fixer brought the snowspeeder closer to the extraction point, Delta and Vau would have to fight their way through an armed patrol of [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] and battle droids to escape. During the skirmish, Vau fell through a hole in the [[Water/Legends|ice]] and into one of the countless [[Whiteworm/Legends|crystal-worm]] tunnels that ran beneath the frozen surface of Mygeeto; although Delta Squad was determined to retrieve him, Vau forcefully commanded them to leave him and get themselves to safety. Despite severe reservations, Delta Squad did as ordered and exfiltrated from Mygeeto, although each would have some difficulty coming to terms with their perceived abandonment of their former sergeant, none more so than Sev.<ref name="TC" /> However, Boss contacted Kal Skirata and Null Captain Ordo once they were off planet to inform them of Vau's situation at the behest of General Jusik; Skirata and Ordo immediately traveled to Mygeeto and managed to extract a [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermic]] but still alive Vau from beneath the Mygeetan ice.<ref name="TC" />

===Hunting Ko Sai===
{{Quote|I know you have little to love the Kaminoans for, gentlemen, but I don't make the rules. Lama Su is adamant that Ko Sai defected and that she didn't die. He won't give his reasons, but that probably doesn't matter because the Chancellor wants a tame Kaminoan scientist for our own use so we aren't beholden to Tipoca, should they ever change their minds about our favored-customer status. So haul her back here. Top priority. He ordered me to put the best team on it.|General Arligan Zey|<ref name="TC" />}}
[[File:Delta_Squad_members.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The members of Delta Squad]]
Upon their return to Coruscant from Mygeeto, Delta Squad was debriefed by General Zey in his office within Special Operations Brigade Headquarters. Upon completion of the debriefing, Zey then informed Delta of their newest orders: [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered the capture of the rogue [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], Kamino's own former [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. Considering her capture as near a priority as locating the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]—if only to deny her expertise to the Separatists, but primarily so as to have an [[Clone Master/Legends|experienced cloner]] unassociated with Tipoca under Republic control—Palpatine insisted that Zey put his most qualified squad on the assignment, from which Zey selected Delta Squad for the task. Ko Sai had gone missing during the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]], and was suspected to have [[Desertion|defected]] to the Confederacy by Kamino's [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]], [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. Despite the length of time between her disappearance and Delta Squad's tasking of her retrieval, Kaminoan intelligence was able to track Ko Sai's movements to the planet [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. Zey would insist that Delta Squad not inform Kal Skirata of their assignment, knowing of the Mandalorian's extreme hate for Kaminoans. Unknown to Delta, Skirata was also hunting for Ko Sai, but for his own reasons: he wished to use the Kaminoan scientist to find a way to halt the accelerating aging that plagued the Grand Army's millions of clones.<ref name="TC" />

Once on the mission, Delta Squad followed the Kaminoans' intelligence reports to Vaynai, and then on to [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]]. From Aquaris, the squad followed a lead to [[Napdu]], the fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Da Soocha]], in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. During this time, Boss was also battling a [[Cold/Legends|cold]], suffering from a repetitive cough and sore throat. Files acquired from the [[Nar Hej Shipping Company]] on Napdu helped Delta to further trace a pattern of movement for Ko Sai, tracking her across the Outer Rim's numerous aquatic worlds toward the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]]. The squad had just transmitted the data back to Special Operations Brigade and General Jusik when they came under attack from a [[Crusher-class starfighter|''Crusher''-class starfighter]] while leaving Napdu in one of the Grand Army's [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel|TIV]] vessels. Delta touched down on Da Soocha's [[Da Soocha III|third moon]], with the ''Crusher'' continuing pursuit; on the ground, Boss used the TIV's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] to blast away one of the ''Crusher''{{'s}} wings, and both Scorch and Sev attacked the wrecked starfighter. During the action, Sev killed the female pilot and her male copilot to Boss's annoyance—dead, they couldn't be interrogated. However, Fixer was able to access the ship's computer and determine that the pair were bounty hunters hired by the Kaminoans to track Ko Sai.<ref name="TC" />

[[File:RC-1140Fixer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Delta Squad's slicer, Fixer]]
With the data from Nar Hej Shipping, Delta tracked down the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Freighter/Legends|freight]] pilot [[Leb Chura]] to [[Kerif City]] on [[Bogg 4]], where they interrogated Chura with the assistance of General Jusik. Chura had been moving cloning materials from [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to [[Dorumaa]], but the Twi'lek had already relayed this information to Skirata and Vau previously. In order to keep Skirata and his quest a secret, Jusik [[Mind trick/Legends|influenced]] Chura to recall Mandalorians wearing [[Color/Legends|green]] armor instead of Skirata and Vau's more recognizable black and [[Gold/Legends|golden]] sets when asked, and upon learning that Chura had delivered the consignment to a location near Dorumaa's [[Tropix Island Resort]], Jusik [[Memory rub/Legends|erased]] the pilot's memory of both Delta and Skirata's band, along with deleting the records on his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. In spite of this, Delta still had their next lead and—after diverting to retrieve [[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|SCUBA trooper]] armor—traveled to the watery [[Tropix Resorts|resort]] world of Dorumaa.<ref name="TC" /> When they arrived, Delta acted as part of a utilities maintenance crew in order to gather surveillance; intercepted communication on the police frequency led them to a collapsed area underneath Tropix's neighboring [[ActionWorld]] island. There, they found the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of a dead human that had been [[Chain (droid)|chained]] beneath the water, and the collapsed entrance facility that had previously belonged to Ko Sai. Skirata and his crew had arrived first, capturing the Kaminoan scientist, destroying the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], and taking her back to [[Kyrimorut/Legends|Skirata's home]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. The squad was tasked with the slow excavation of the area; at one point they were able to insert a small [[strip-cam]] through an available opening, finding the armored remains of the Mandalorian bodyguards Ko Sai had hired.<ref name="TC" />

After weeks of excavation under the observation of Jusik, Delta Squad would uncover no evidence of Ko Sai—there was none to be found since she had been wisked unwillingly away to Mandalore. They would, however, remain unyieldingly loyal in covering for Jusik's absence while the Jedi Knight [[Force healing/Legends|attended]] to the severely injured Fi on Coruscant. Five hundred and forty-eight days into the Clone Wars, the commandos of Delta Squad would be called back to Special Operations Brigade on Coruscant where they were met by Kal Skirata. There, Skirata gave Sev a package containing Ko Sai's severed head; the rogue Kaminoan had taken her own life while being held on Mandalore, and was cut into pieces post-mortem. Sev then delivered Ko Sai's head to General Zey for confirmation of death, neglecting the details of how it had come into Delta's possession while still telling Zey as much of the truth as he knew using tightly wound word games. Though he had been hoping for a better outcome, Zey still congratulated Delta Squad on their good work in finding Ko Sai, and rewarded their efforts with a day's leave to do with what they wished.<ref name="TC" />

===The war drags on===
{{Quote|It's not right. Clones shouldn't mix with officers. Let alone ''Jedi'' officers.''"<br />"''What, in case we get ideas above our station? Don't know our place, die nice and quietly so we don't upset the civvies?''"<br />"''You spend too long talking to Fi and those Null dingbats, Scorch.''"<br />"''You've seen the average galactic citizen now. We didn't know any better on Kamino. If anyone's superior, it's ''us'', not them.|Fixer and Scorch|<ref name="O66" />}}
Seven hundred and thirty-six days after the Battle of Geonosis—on the second anniversary of the start of the Clone Wars—the members of Delta Squad would find themselves at Arca Barracks on Coruscant awaiting assignment. While there, Scorch and Sev came upon Kal Skirata and Walon Vau together on the barracks' parade ground, engaged with reciting the names of fallen clone commandos, both from within their respective training [[Company/Legends|companies]] and without, in the Mandalorian custom for honoring dead comrades and loved ones. Upon investigating, both Sev and Scorch ended up joining the two sergeants in the commemoration ritual, along with a number of other commandos who joined in as the list of names went on. When they reached the list's end, Skirata took the time to say a few encouraging words to the assembled soldiers, and wished them all to stay safe so that they might be able to see his [[Venku Skirata|young grandson]] grow up. As the crowd dispersed, Sev turned his attention toward calibrating his [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]], although Scorch kept an eye on his former training sergeant long enough to see Vau and Skirata meeting with fellow former Mandalorian ''Cuy'val Dar'' trainers [[Mij Gilamar]] and [[Wad'e Tay'haai]] for reasons unknown to the two commandos.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:SevBossFixer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sev, Boss and Fixer]]
Several months later, approximately nine hundred and seventy days into the war, Delta Squad found themselves on the Separatist-aligned [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Haurgab]]. Originally, while Jedi General [[Mlaske]] and the Grand Army's [[85th Infantry Brigade]] were already [[Battle of Haurgab|operating]] on Haurgab, the only Republic commando presence on the dusty backwater world had been Omega Squad, sent to assassinate a [[Jolluc|key leader]] of the pro-Separatist [[Maujasi]]. However, as time passed, the Republic began to assign more and more Grand Army forces to Haurgab and Delta Squad, much to their displeasure, soon became among them.<ref name="O66" /> During a visit from General Etain Tur-Mukan—having replaced Bardan Jusik as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Delta Squad's [[Commando Group]], [[Zero Five Commando]], following his resignation as a Jedi General and his departure from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]—the four members of Delta Squad joined a number of other clone troops in the mess hall of [[Hadde Base|the Republic's base]] on the outskirts of the Haurgab city of [[Hadde]]. While Delta was sitting down at a table with their food, the base was struck by a [[Huntmaster missile|missile]] from within the city limits; though numerous troopers were killed and wounded in the attack both from the blast and the resultant shrapnel, Delta Squad had been spared the worst injuries thanks to their hardy ''Katarn'' armor. Their Omega Squad compatriots survived without injury as well, and together the two squads led the counter-attack on the rebel forces, along with with General Tur-Mukan and elements of the 85th and [[14th Infantry Brigade]]s.<ref name="O66" /> As Delta and Omega rode into the city atop patrol vehicles, flanked by multiple [[Nek Pup armored gun platform|Nek Pup]] armored gun platforms for fire support, Scorch was having a difficult time dealing with the attack on the base and the deaths of the troopers in the mess. When they had arrived at the house where the missile had originated, Scorch insisted on being part of the assault team for the raid while the rest of Delta stood by as security to deal with any potential attack from another source. Omega Squad's Darman blew open the door with a [[breaching grenade]], and Scorch lobbed another grenade through the blasted-open entrance before following Atin and [[Corr Skirata|Corr]]—Omega Squad's replacement for Fi, following a traumatic brain injury during a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] to [[Gaftikar]]—into the house. During the shootout, four rebels were taken captive, while another three were killed. Death would prove not to be enough for Scorch, however: the infuriated commando dragged the rebels' lifeless bodies out into the street where he riddled them with blasterfire before finally spitting on each of the charred corpses. General Tur-Mukan made a point of speaking with Scorch afterward, offering to ease his mind with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="O66" />

Nine hundred and ninety-seven days after the Battle of Geonosis, just over four weeks after the events on Haurgab, Delta Squad was present during a secret meeting between their former training sergeant Walon Vau and General Arligan Zey, wherein Vau was asked by Zey to keep an eye out for any anti-Republic actions being taken by his fellow ''Cuy'val Dar'', Kal Skirata. Though the squad did not believe Skirata would do anything to jeopardize the clones he'd come to care so much about, Vau instructed Delta to remain out of the affair for their own good. The next day, they would again be present as Vau delivered a report to Zey in which he insinuated that although [[Jilka Zan Zentis|the culprit]] delving into the [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] system had turned out not to be Skirata, Vau had forcefully persuaded Skirata not to cause any more further trouble. Vau then stated his intent to extract the true culprit from [[Republic Domestic Security]] custody in order to question her, and although Delta Squad offered their assistance in the matter, Vau would turn down their offer and instead instructed the commandos to focus their attention on their next mission.<ref name="O66" />

===Kashyyyk===
====Rescue of Tarfful====
{{Quote|Welcome to Kashyyyk. Thanks to the data you found on that assault ship, the Republic and the Wookiees are on very good terms. They've asked us to help find their leader, a Wookiee named Tarfful. Tarfful spent years fighting Trandoshan slavers. Two days ago, one of his patrols was overwhelmed—the Wookiees assumed he was lost. However, we've recently cracked a Trandoshan code indicating Tarfful was captured. Be advised, this is a ''covert'' insertion. He is still alive and being held in a slave camp here on Kashyyyk. At least you have the element of surprise, this time. Good luck.|Advisor 01/425, briefing Delta Squad on their new objective|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:LAATiDeltaSquad-RC.png|thumb|left|250px|Delta Squad inserts onto Kashyyyk]]
Around one thousand and seventy days after the Battle of Geonosis,<ref name="O66" /> Delta Squad was sent to the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. Following a Separatist-backed invasion by Trandoshan slavers, the Wookiee [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] had been taken prisoner. Tarfful had spent years combating Trandoshan slaving parties, and without him the Wookiees turned to the Republic for assistance. In response, Delta Squad was deployed to Kashyyyk in order to extract Tarfful from captivity, in a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Clone Wars)|mission]] that would see Delta under the oversight of Advisor 01/425 yet again.<ref name="RepCom" />

Delta Squad covertly inserted into Kashyyyk via LAAT/i gunship, [[Rappel line|rappelling]] down to the planet's surface from the troop bay. Once on the ground, the squad moved through the planet's dense jungle until coming upon the camp of the Trandoshan slavers. Battling their way inside, the squad was ambushed in a narrow corridor by Trandoshan mercenaries on the overhead catwalks, forcing them to make an escape through a maintenance shaft toward a landing zone. After securing the landing zone, the commandos caught a glimpse of a [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]], matching its profile to General Grievous' ship, ''Soulless One''. Continuing through the slaver's base, Delta freed a number of imprisoned Wookiees on their way to locate Tarfful before Delta's advisor tasked the squad with another objective: confirming Grievous' presence on Kashyyyk. Climbing a tower close to the General's landing pad, Delta managed a visual confirmation on the General himself, before nearly being attacked by one of Grievous' [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. Rushing down the tower, Delta Squad found Tarfful being escorted to Grievous' fighter by two MagnaGuards; although Tarfful was able to successfully destroy the droids on his own, Grievous fled the planet in his starfighter, leaving behind another pair of MagnaGuards. Though Grievous had initially wanted the Wookiee chieftain alive for questioning, once denied of that opportunity, the commander of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] instead ordered Tarfful dead so as to deny the Republic the valuable intelligence Tarfful possessed. Delta Squad engaged the deadly droids in an effort to protect Tarfful, although the Wookiee warrior refused to back down from his attackers. Together, the commandos and their Wookiee ally defeated the droids, and Tarfful was taken to Coruscant in order to enlist further Republic assistance.<ref name="RepCom" />

====Further actions====

Delta, regroup—we're going after Sev.|Forward Air Controller|Negative negative, Three-Eight, new orders came through from the generals—clear the area and evac now.|Boss|I don't care if they came from General Yoda himself. Sev—|FAC|As a matter of fact, they ''did'', soldier. Now get your squad out of there.|Fixer|He's right, Boss. We've got to get out ''now''.|Scorch|We can't leave Sev. ''Nobody'' gets left behind. Remember? Remember how Sev blew up when we left Vau on Mygeeto? You want to do that to ''our brother''? You want to abandon him? Leave him behind?|attr=Fixer, Boss, and Scorch argue with the General Vos' Forward Air Controller when Sev comes under fire and loses contact.|audio=|url=|src=<ref name="O66" />}}
[[File:Kashyyyk_mission.jpg|thumb|250px|Delta Squad moving on the Trandoshan compound]]
With Tarfful free of his captors, Delta Squad assaulted another Trandoshan encampment in the forests of Kashyyyk. There, they found that the camp was not simply another Trandoshan slavers camp, but a Separatist supply base and a staging ground for a full-scale attack on Kashyyyk. With this knowledge in mind, Advisor 01/425 ordered the squad to infiltrate the encampment and do as much damage to the Separatists operations as possible. While assaulting the base, Delta encountered an armed [[Mine/Legends|minefield]] which they managed to deactivate, only to reactivate the mines with the arrival of a number of droidekas; using the Separatists own mines, Delta destroyed the attacking droidekas and continued on to a nearby landing pad.<ref name="RepCom" /> Fighting off waves of Trandoshan mercenaries bolstered by the arrival of a Trandoshan dropship filled with supplies and fresh troops, Delta Squad destroyed the landing platform before receiving orders to shut down the base. The squad encountered an advanced spider droid—which they were able to destroy by releasing a cargo crane's payload over top of the droid—before being joined by a LAAT/i gunship which finished off the droid presence and airlifted Delta Squad out of the Trandoshan base.<ref name="RepCom" />

By this point in time—1,070 days after the Battle of Geonosis—Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan had been sent to join Delta Squad on Kashyyyk by Arligan Zey; though Zey did not doubt Delta's ability to complete the mission on their own, he felt that they would benefit from Tur-Mukan's presence onworld. Upon destroying the Separatist–Trandoshan staging base, Tur-Mukan relayed the significance of the [[Kachirho Bridge|Kachirho bridge]] to the commandos of Delta Squad—were the bridge to be destroyed, the Separatist supply lines would be cut off, while the Wookiees would be able to construct smaller bridges to circumvent the loss, an option the Confederacy's battle droids didn't have.<ref name="O66" />

[[File:KachirhoBridge-RC.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The bridge at Kachirho, which Delta was tasked to destroy.]]
Moving through an occupied market concourse, Delta fought their way through numerous Trandoshan grenadiers and heavily armed mercenaries<ref name="RepCom" /> aided by a defense force of Wookiees defending their homes, tearing Trandoshans [[Limb/Legends|limb]] from limb.<ref name="O66" /> After battling another advanced spider droid and countless battle droids atop the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] [[Kachirho Bridge|Bridge]], Delta Squad placed a [[detonation pack]] at the center of the bridge where it was weakest. However, when Boss attempted to detonate the charge, the explosives suffered a misfire.<ref name="RepCom" /> Undeterred, Scorch borrowed a [[Wookiee Guided Rocket Launcher|rocket launcher]] from a female Wookiee, and used it to destroy the bridge.<ref name="O66" /> Thirteen days later, Delta would continue operations on Kashyyyk, even as Coruscant came [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] by General Grievous. While preparing to ambush a Separatist droid patrol, Scorch and Sev listened in to the comlink traffic from Coruscant, learning that only commandos in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] had received the [[Code Five]] signal to return to Coruscant immediately. When General Tur-Mukan expressed her concern for her loved ones residing on the Republic's besieged capital, Delta Squad took it upon themselves to comfort her, and when she revealed that she had a [[Venku Skirata|son]], they promised to keep her secret. Though the battle droid patrol would fall victim to Wookiee-make pitfalls, Delta and Tur-Mukan ambushed a small group of Trandoshans scouting through the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]], disposing of their dead bodies via a carnivorous plant.<ref name="O66" />

Five days later, with the crisis on Coruscant over, Delta Squad was joined on Kashyyyk by the clone forces of Jedi General [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], arriving from [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. In addition, General Yoda was inbound with the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]] and Wookiee Chieftain Tarfful, set to land within thirty standard minutes. However, a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] had taken up position to engage Yoda's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and halt the debarking of additional ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. With a bit of good-natured coaxing from General Tur-Mukan, Delta Squad infiltrated a Separatist turbolaser battery complex with the intent to commandeer the contained firepower to take out the ''Recusant''-class [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]. With Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] considering alternative landing sites—each too far removed from the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|main offensive]] to be effective—Delta Squad captured one [[Wookiee dual missile turret]] for each commando, and opened fire on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] destroyer, joined in the attack by a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of General Vos' LAAT/i gunships. After sustaining heavy damage, the Recusant destroyer began to fall, but while the majority of Delta Squad planned for a hasty exit, Sev radioed in with a report of coming under attack from multiple hostiles. When Boss ordered the squad to go back for Sev, Vos' [[Forward Air Controller/Legends|Forward Air Controller]] instead ordered Delta to leave, stating that the order had come directly from General Yoda himself. Though Scorch argued to the point of tears, Boss forced him to comply and moved the remaining three members of Delta Squad onto the gunship that had arrived to extract them, but not without first making a guilty apology to Sev.<ref name="O66" />

Onboard the gunship, Advisor 01/425 confronted Boss via hologram and ordered him to get his squad under control. The advisor then patched through a transmission from General Yoda, who stated that Delta Squad's efforts had enabled the Republic to establish forward command in Kachirho, and that the Republic would continue to rely on their skills in the coming battle. Delta Squad was then retasked with a new set of objectives for Kashyyyk.<ref name="RepCom" />

===Imperial service===
{{Quote|I ''hate'' this. And we've got some new guy taking Sev's place. It's temporary, though. He'd better understand that.|Scorch, on his new life as an Imperial Commando|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
Not long after the conclusion of Republic action on Kashyyyk and the issuing of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which branded the Jedi traitors to the Republic who were to be shot on sight, the Clone Wars would come to an end when the old Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], under the leadership of the now [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine. Nearly eleven-hundred days after the Battle of Geonosis, the three remaining members of Delta Squad found themselves stationed at the [[Imperial Army Training Center]] on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], one of the moons of Coruscant and the location of the secret [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]-based [[Clone trooper/Legends#Palpatine.27s Secret Army|second clone army]] that Palpatine had created. There, they would continue to lament the loss of Sev, especially in the face of the revelation that although Omega Squad members Atin and Corr had deserted the Grand Army, Darman and Niner had joined Delta in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] because Darman had refused to leave a [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|badly wounded]] Niner behind on his own.<ref name="O66" />

Three weeks after the formation of the new Empire, Delta Squad—with a new replacement for Sev among their ranks—gathered at the [[501st Legion headquarters]] on Coruscant with a number of other former Republic commandos and Advanced Recon Commandos for an audience with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. There, Vader reformed the Republic's former [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] soldiers as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], an elite unit within the Imperial [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] that would be tasked with hunting down Jedi who managed to escape Order 66, along with clone deserters, Jedi sympathizers, and other Imperial dissidents. Their serial numbers' "RC" prefix replaced with an "IC" to denote their new position as Imperial Commandos, the squad would also find themselves given a different and more numerically-based name, similar to the former Omega Squad being deemed "[[Squad 40]]."<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> Although initially under the command of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Sa Cuis]], the Imperial Commando Special Unit would be taken over by Imperial Commander [[Roly Melusar]]—a native of the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and a man with a firm hatred of all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]—following [[Duel on Vohai|Cuis' death]]. Though Fixer was impressed by Melusar's earnest style of command, it would be Melusar's zealous hate for the Jedi and all other beings who could wield the Force that would lead Scorch to tag Melusar with the nickname of "Holy Roly", a name that would in fact stick among the ranks of the Imperial Commando Special Unit.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Members==
===Sergeant RC-1138 “Boss”===
{{Quote|Alone against all these droids...heh, they don't stand a chance.|Boss|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:RC-1138.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Boss]]
{{Main|Boss (clone commando)/Legends}}
RC-1138, or "Boss" was Delta Squad's Sergeant who led them throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As a soldier, Boss had earned both the respect and loyalty of his squad and in return he did his all to be a strong and effective leader.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Relatively taciturn, Boss was not a man of many words, and much of what he ''did'' say came in the form of orders issued to the other members of Delta Squad. Interestingly enough, despite being raised and trained by ''Cuy'val Dar'' sergeant Walon Vau, Boss would come to speak with Jango Fett's own [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] accent and speech patterns<ref name="TCSWE" />—though this trait was common to the flash-learned standard clone troops, as well.<ref name="AOTC" /> Boss cared a great deal for his squad, and like most other clone commandos, viewed his squadmates as brothers.<ref name="TC" />

===RC-1140 "Fixer"===
{{Quote|Sir, you realize this is against recommended protocols.|Fixer|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:RC-1140.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Fixer]]
{{Main|RC-1140/Legends}}
RC-1140, or "Fixer" to his comrades, was the acknowledged second-in-command of Delta Squad, and was a soldier who believed in doing his job by the book. Fixer was the squad's expert in all things technological, and was justly the squad's go-to man for slicing and code-breaking. Gruff in his demeanor, and a serious no-nonsense type of person, Fixer had a habit of calling his squadmates by their numerical designations rather than their chosen nicknames.<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="RepCom" /> Fixer often took it upon himself to curtail the playful teasing of his squadmates Sev and Scorch while in the field,<ref name="RepCom" /> though he would occasionally engage in the verbal sparring during down time.<ref name="O66" />

===RC-1207 “Sev”===
{{Quote|In order to achieve maximum combat efficiency, some guys say they need to get in the zone. Sir, I ''live'' in the zone.|Sev|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:RC-1207.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Sev]]
{{Main|Sev/Legends}}
RC-1207, who drew upon his designation's final digit to don the name "Sev,"<ref name="O66" /> was Delta Squad's most skilled [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]<ref name="RepCom" /> and perhaps its fiercest fighter. Sev enjoyed combat, and decorated his commando armor with [[Blood/Legends|blood]]-[[Color/Legends|red]] markings<ref name="TCSWE" /> that not everyone could tell whether it was paint or real blood.<ref name="TZ" /> Sev possessed a grim sense of humor<ref name="TCSWE" /> and a powerful drive to succeed, believing that any failure of his would be letting his training sergeant, Walon Vau, down and disappointing him. Though he deeply respected and revered Vau, Sev also felt a sense of jealously toward the commandos who had been trained by Kal Skirata, who treated his trainees as though they were his sons.<ref name="TZ" /> A common joke among the rest of Delta Squad was that Sev was a bit of a [[:Wikipedia:Psychopathy|psychopath]], even teasing that his [[cloning tank]] had been spiked during gestation.<ref name="RepCom" /> Sev kept a count of every Geonosian that he killed during the course of the Clone Wars, intending to reach a goal of 4,982—the number of clone commandos killed during the Battle of Geonosis, for which Sev intended to take revenge.<ref name="O66" />

===RC-1262   " Scorch "===
[[File:RC-1262.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Scorch]]
{{Quote|If we're all clones, why am I the only one with a sense of humor?|Scorch|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
{{Main|Scorch/Legends}}
RC-1262 acquired the name of "Scorch" following an ordnance accident that left him and his training sergeant, Walon Vau, without eyebrows for a brief period of time. A competent soldier, Scorch served as Delta Squad's explosive technician,<ref name="TCSWE" /> performing demolition and rapid entry duties for the squad on a number of missions, a job which he thoroughly enjoys.<ref name="RepCom" /> Aside from his talents with explosive ordnance, Scorch possessed an overdeveloped sense of irony and found his place in the squad as their resident wisecracker, able to find humor in almost any situation.<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="RepCom" /> Scorch spent much of his time verbally sparring with fellow squad member Sev, playfully maintaining a brotherly relationship of back-and-forth teasing and friendly rivalry.<ref name="RepCom" />Even though he was the jokester of Delta Squad, Scorch was enraged when Delta Squad had to leave one of their own, Sev, behind.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|You know, I gotta thank whoever designed this ''Katarn''-class armor for us. It's great stuff. But obviously, they never thought we'd need to sit down. Ouch.|Scorch|<ref name="RepCom" />}}
[[File:DC-17m_Interchangable_Weapon_System.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] and [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15s]], wielded by Delta Squad]]
Like all Republic commando squads in the Grand Army of the Republic, Delta Squad's commandos wore ''Katarn''-class commando armor that was stronger and more durable than [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|the standard]] [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by regular clone troopers. Each member of the squad chose to decorate their armor with different paint schemes and colors unique to them.<ref name="RepCom" /> On certain occasions, the commandos would incorporate impromptu camouflage into their armor by using dirt and moss spread over the surface. Their helmets possessed advanced [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up displays]] (HUDs), along with sophisticated comlink systems that could broadcast long range or appear to be silent to anyone outside of the squad channel or even outside of the wearer's own helmet.<ref name="RepCom" /><ref name="TZ" /> Delta Squad also made use of the [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System]], and though each commando held a preference for certain attachments for the rifle, all were highly trained in the use of each of them. The [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15s]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] was the issued sidearm for both Delta Squad, and all of their clone commando comrades.<ref name="RepCom" /><ref name="TZ" /> Delta also enjoyed the use of a number of non-standard issue weaponry acquired during missions,<ref name="RepCom" /> and had access to specialized equipment like SCUBA trooper gear.<ref name="TC" /> Upon serving the Galactic Empire as Imperial commandos, Delta was issued new black Imperial commando armor, but they were allowed to keep their old DC-17 rifles.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DeltaSquad-RCconcept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of Delta Squad disembarking from an LAAT/i.]]
Delta Squad first appeared in the [[2005]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''. The squad would make subsequent appearances in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]] of novels by author [[Karen Traviss]], beginning with the second entry in the series, ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', in which Delta joined the main story immediately after the second mission undertaken in the original game. Delta Squad would continue to feature in Traviss' subsequent Republic Commando novels [[Republic Commando: True Colors|''True Colors'']] and [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], along with the first and currently only ''Imperial Commando'' novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''.

The events of Delta Squad's mission to Kashyyyk differ in their portrayal from the video game to ''Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel''. In the novel, Delta's advisor is left out entirely, with his role filled by Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan and later General Quinlan Vos' Forward Air Controller. There are also a number of other small changes ranging from dialogue, to courses of action taken by Delta Squad's commandos. This article takes steps to reconcile the differences whenever possible, with ''Order 66'' taking preference when a compromise is not possible, as it is the more recent source.

An action figure of Scorch was made by Hasbro in early [[2006]] and, along with [[Foul Moudama]], marked a tentative exploration of [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] characters. Scorch was short-packed and sold out quickly, making him hard to find and highly sought-after. At Comic-Con 2006, it was announced that the rest of Delta Squad would be turned into action figures as a set of four along with three Geonosian warriors. The seven-figure set was exclusive to [http://www.starwarsshop.com StarWarsShop.com] in the Fall of 2006. Subsequently a new smaller set with all 4 Commandos and a Geonosian Warrior was released first as a Comic-Con/Internet exclusive, and as a Toys 'R' Us exclusive in August.

At one point during the game, Delta-62 will exclaim, "That was for Delta-23...or was it 32?", indicating a potential friendship with a fallen member of a fellow "Delta"-designated unit.
